page.layout: One page of text, one column at full width; running head across the top with page number at the right; a small marginal note "V 3" and "Verf." set at the lower right of the text block, within the column. No margin notes beside the column.

p.i: num omnes linguis loquuntur? num omnes interpretantur?

main_text.p: Tertium argumentum, quod in ultimo versu breviter proponitur, fusius in sequente capite tractandum, est à praestantiâ & naturâ charitatis, quæ neq; sine salutis omniisque dignitatis iactura abesse, neque cum prauis illis affectibus vnâ consistere potest.
31 Æmulamini autem dona meliora & adhuc excellentiorem viam vobis demonstro.

page.notes: The running head "Cap. 12." reads "Cap.xii." in the scan; the verse-marker "V 3" and "Verf." are printed at the lower right of the column as catchwords/side references. Some letters in the running head and line 4 ("omniisque", "dignitatis") are uncertain from the scan. The small mark "V 3" is probably a reference to the following verse and is set in the text block, not a margin note. Show-through and scan damage at the lower page are not transcribed.
